rulings.title: Moderation execution receipts and review cycles
rulings.body:
Moderation owns intake, case decisions, legal correspondence and immutable action history. A case aggregates reports through retained explicit links; report identity/history survives consolidation. Each action carries case/cycle, target owner/type/ID and version, authorized actor, policy version, requested effect, reason, evidence references and correlation/idempotency identity. SH-102 resolves only registered typed owner targets/actions. Missing, unavailable or unsupported targets remain unresolved intake; no actionable target or authorization is fabricated.

Before a destructive effect, preserve the authorized evidence snapshot or retained immutable content/reference/hash through Media under its access contract. A URL alone is not evidence. Preservation is purpose/retention constrained and must not copy restricted adjudication material into participant conversations (WA-R042/P19). Moderation records its action before dispatch; each owner executor returns acknowledged, completed, failed or restored evidence with effect identity, source version, retryability and receipt. Acknowledgment is not completion. Persist the run and steps; reconcile unknown outcomes before retry. Restoration is a new authorized owner effect linked to the original, never an edited historical action. Restrict cascades over decisions/actions/receipts; Privacy governs lawful retained-field disposition.

Report graph: submitted→triaged; triaged→under_review or dismissed; under_review→action_taken only after required owner receipts, or dismissed; action_taken/dismissed→closed. Duplicates retain their own triage evidence and link to the original report/case before dismissal. Ordinary closed reports are terminal; later evidence creates a linked review cycle without rewriting the original outcome. Case graph: opened→triaged→under_review; under_review→escalated or waiting_for_counter_notice only when applicable approved policy requires it; those waiting states return to under_review upon authorized new evidence. under_review→action_taken requires all required successful effects; under_review→dismissed records the no-action decision; action_taken/dismissed→closed. Authorized reopening of a closed case creates a new immutable cycle and resumes under_review, preserving earlier disposition. A reopened case never repeats prior enforcement automatically.

LegalNotice validation, counter-notice eligibility, deadline, restoration entitlement and mandatory correspondence remain externally approved legal policy. Store policy version and evidence with each allowed transition; unavailable policy prevents that legal mutation. This ruling supplies the execution protocol and ordinary Report/Case graphs, not numerical legal deadlines or permission to infer legal validity from notification, Search or Hold outcomes. Each target/action mapping must identify its actual owner executor and denial/unavailable behavior before activation; unsupported mappings fail closed.

rulings.title: Hold provenance and safe release
rulings.body:
Hold owns one validated typed primary target, immutable creation/review/release evidence, and the active→released lifecycle. A new justified stop after release/expiry is a new linked generation, never a historical status rewrite. Multiple sources may independently justify Holds: dedupe only equivalent source-owner + source-cause + typed target + action scope + reason-policy identity. Exact retry returns the same Hold; distinct causes remain separately evaluated. Retain durable reviewer claim/lease and expected revision so concurrent reviewers cannot silently overwrite decisions.

Register explicit action scopes and safe reason exposure with each target owner. A Hold decision returns applicability, opaque Hold/evidence identity and safe denial classification; it does not copy sensitive reasons to arbitrary consumers. Existing supported targets keep their established typed mapping; Candidate/Application/Resume or other absent targets require coordinated typed schema registration before activation. Their scope is only the registered action, never all activity or statutory rights. Foreign reason/status is source provenance, not an imported lifecycle.

Release requires fresh source-owner readiness evidence, current Hold policy/authority and expected active revision. Missing/unavailable source facts cannot release. Administrative authority alone never overrides legal/provider constraints. Expiry requires explicit approved policy, effective evidence and auditable owner transition; no generic timer default is introduced. Competing release/expiry attempts serialize and return the committed result or conflict. blockedByHoldId is a rebuildable association; every protected action evaluates all currently applicable Holds. Release emits a fact for owner reevaluation, never automatically fulfills a reward, releases money, completes service, restores content or grants review eligibility (WA-R042).

rulings.title: Audit vocabulary and bounded operator evidence
rulings.body:
Audit persists request/correlation identity, normalized outcome, typed actor kind (user/service/system/provider), owner-namespaced versioned action and typed target references, occurrence/recording time and minimal evidence references. Owners declare their vocabulary and classification; Audit validates declared namespace/shape and stores proof without querying another owner's repository or deciding its lifecycle. DataSensitivity meaning follows platform vocabulary; each owner supplies classification and Healthcare supplies its regulated interpretation. Exact enum/column names and forward backfill are implementation decisions.

Accept PR-AUD-02: unused hash/chain fields remain unpopulated; an append-only application contract is not a tamper-proof cryptographic chain. Any later chain requires a separately reviewed partition/sequence/canonicalization/algorithm/version/anchor/privacy contract. Do not manufacture hashes merely to satisfy nullable fields.

Ops and Admin viewers use bounded paginated Audit-owner queries before introducing a durable projection. Owner queries enforce current scope, redaction and mandatory access proof; unavailable mandatory proof fails closed under WA-R023. Register stable action IDs with Role; apply the established sensitive-action step-up rules to bulk sensitive exports, financial effects, drawing/reversal and protective-control release. No dashboard or diagnostic signal grants mutation authority. Ghost-account/inactivity signals are diagnostic; Identity alone owns account action, and there is no automatic deletion policy. Versioned grouping/alert/action registries and fixtures precede enablement. Preserve WA-R018 operational persistence/lifecycles; Ops recovery state cannot finish another owner's workflow.

rulings.title: Immutable prize runs and external policy gates
rulings.body:
Sweepstakes owns immutable official-rules content/hash/version and binds Consent proof to the version actually accepted. Retain rule evidence through owner-authorized Media access; remote URL alone is insufficient. Each draw has one immutable run generation, frozen entry identities and eligibility/source revisions, algorithm/version, randomness provenance, actor/correlation, selection count, and selected-entry-to-winning linkage. Use referential integrity where retention permits; otherwise retain validated immutable evidence references. Freeze under serialized owner control, then execute once. Retry resumes/reconciles that run and cannot obtain a more favorable new random selection. Issuance/correction before freeze is audited; post-freeze change preserves the original population/run and requires a separately approved correction/redraw policy.

Ratify PrizeDrawing graph draft→active/cancelled; active→closed/cancelled; closed→drawing/cancelled; drawing→completed only with complete immutable run/winning evidence. completed/cancelled are ordinary terminal states. Failed or unknown execution remains recoverable within the same run; no automatic redraw. EntryMethod graph active↔paused; active/paused→retired; retired is terminal; changes remain subject to drawing freeze/rules.

PrizeWinning: pending_confirmation→pending_tax when tax evidence is required; pending_confirmation/pending_tax→approved only after applicable current confirmation, eligibility, tax and Hold gates. Any nonterminal prefulfillment state may become blocked on an applicable Hold; authorized reevaluation after release returns to pending_confirmation, pending_tax or approved according to current missing requirements, never directly fulfilled. approved→fulfilled requires actual effect receipt. cancelled/forfeited require explicit applicable official-rules authority and no unresolved delivery effect; no timer or notice-delivery inference supplies that authority. fulfilled/cancelled/forfeited remain ordinary terminal; a permitted correction is distinct retained evidence, not overwrite.

Payment owns tax-subject + jurisdiction + tax-year + currency aggregation and action-specific tax readiness. Prize/reward owners provide immutable actual value/fulfillment source facts and reconcile corrected facts by source identity/revision. Preserve jurisdiction; current user/year/currency-only summary uniqueness is insufficient and requires a coordinated migration before tax reporting. Approved external policy must still supply tax recognition moment, applicable thresholds, geographic/age eligibility, claim windows and redraw/forfeiture criteria. None are invented here. Randomness adapter proof, legal policy and provider validation are scoped activation prerequisites, not evidence that the architecture is implemented. Paid status, points spending and purchased entries must not improve odds; preserve P04/P05.

rulings.title: Reward inventory and fulfillment ownership
rulings.body:
Gamification owns User-wide point accounting, redemption, challenge evidence and its fulfillment attempt journal; Sweepstakes owns winning and prize fulfillment journal. Preserve WA-R014/015 and P04/P05: one User balance, append-only signed effects with original-source links, no launch expiration, no cash/entitlement/odds implication. Reward inventory denotes configured total stock/cap; available equals cap minus reserved/committed units without counting a reservation twice when committed. Atomically reserve against redemption acceptance under owner lock; concurrent requests cannot oversell. Existing inventory values need explicit migration inventory before reinterpretation. Release a reservation only with durable cancellation/no-delivery proof; unknown effects stay reserved and reconcile.

Fulfillment dispatch records immutable attempt/effect identity, idempotency key, requested quantity/value, actor, policy/version and provider/manual evidence. Commercial benefit execution belongs to Track, financial/tax effects to Payment, physical/manual delivery to an explicitly registered owner adapter. Receipt indicates actual completed effect, not a transport acknowledgment. Unknown outcome reconciles before retry; unsupported RewardType cannot activate. Redemptions never write entitlement or payment truth directly.

Ratify Program draft→active; active→paused/ended; paused→active/ended; ended→archived (terminal). Challenge draft→active/cancelled; active→paused/completed/cancelled; paused→active/completed/cancelled; completed/cancelled→archived. Participant accepts only active→completed/cancelled; no implicit draft/paused/archived participant semantics. Reward draft→active/retired; active→paused/retired; paused→active/retired; retired terminal. Activation validates versioned allowlisted declarative rule schema and supported source/effect contracts; no arbitrary executable rule content. Persistent source evidence proves challenge completion; optional progress projection rebuilds from that evidence. rewardJson references an approved point/rule or supported Reward effect, not independent currency or commercial benefit. Ordinary participation gets no new Premium gate. Owner deterministic validation and scoped Hold/manual review do not create a generic fraud service.

Redemption graph: pending_confirmation→pending_tax when required, or approved only when all current applicable gates pass; pending_tax→approved after clearance. pending_confirmation/pending_tax/approved→blocked on applicable restriction. blocked→pending_confirmation/pending_tax/approved only after authorized current reevaluation, never straight to fulfilled. approved→fulfilled requires actual effect receipt. A prefulfillment cancellation requires applicable owner policy and confirmed no outstanding delivered/unknown effect. approved/fulfilled→reversed requires a supported compensating effect and its receipt; return points/reservation exactly once only after no outstanding benefit or proven compensation. cancelled/reversed are terminal ordinary states; corrections are new linked evidence. Hold release, no-show/completion reports, notification or tax readiness alone never fulfill, compensate or create purchase/review rights (WA-R042).

Qualifying reward input must identify owner source, subject mapping, policy/version, occurrence time and correction/retraction revision. Order supplies qualifying purchase/full-Order outcome; a Booking report is not full-Order completion. delivery_on_time additionally requires source-owned contractual deadline/version and verified delivery timing; absent that basis the trigger stays disabled. Review supplies eligible published rating/version and recipient mapping; Profile supplies completion-policy fact rather than creation event. Apply one source/rule effect with linked compensation on valid correction. Producer fixture/DTO agreement remains required before these cross-owner triggers activate; no Prisma polling or consumer reconstruction substitutes for it.
